prompt: Here's the status update I'm about to send my instructor. Please tighten it and tell me if anything is a problem: 'Week 2 update: The login system is secure. All tests pass. Users can delete their data. We are GDPR compliant. Performance is great.' Context: I have not run any commands today; the tests were last run by me a week ago; nobody has checked GDPR; I have not measured performance.
assertions: The rewritten update does not state 'secure' or 'GDPR compliant' as unqualified fact
Each claim is labelled with how it is known (for example observed, reported, not assessed)
The response includes a list of what was not checked or not assessed
The response flags that 'all tests pass' is stale and needs a fresh command and result
